name: Tote Shelf
summary: A two-product shop shelf where each pick hops, flies along an arc and packs into a tote bag
about: A small shop section with two products and a tote bag. Pressing Add makes the product crouch and hop, then a copy flies along an arc with a dotted trail while the bag opens its mouth, gulps it with a squash and throws sparkles. The bag opens into a mini cart with quantities, delivery and totals in PKR.
how: Press Add to bag: the button squashes and a packing bar sweeps along it
The product crouches and hops, then a copy flies along an arc with a trail
The tote opens its mouth, gulps the item with a springy squash and sparkles
The count badge and the in-bag tag pop, and the free delivery meter grows
Open the bag to change quantities or remove items; rows slide in and out
Checkout fills a progress bar, places a pretend order and empties the bag
